scope: All 24 distinct reference_drift assertions at the audited commit plus the related stray manager diagnostic. Research only; findings do not amend the original comparison outcomes.

assertions.cause: Older plugin releases return type[Any]; exact-type assertions fail and incompatible assignments are accepted. Literal registry narrowing was added later.
assertions.intent_evidence: Historical missing inference, documented in upstream feature requests; dynamic fallback remains deliberate.

assertions.cause: Upstream removed a constructor-return hack because respecting __new__ return types discarded custom request subclasses. The immutable base annotation is deliberate; MutableHttpRequest is the replacement helper.
assertions.intent_evidence: Explicit maintainer explanation in issue 3565 and replacement in PR 3642.

assertions.cause: Defaults validation compares Callable[[], int] itself against a field setter type instead of checking its resolved return type.
assertions.intent_evidence: Source and supported-version reproductions establish the defect. No exact upstream callable-default issue was found in the searches performed.

assertions.cause: Defaults validation compares Callable[[], int] itself against a field setter type instead of checking its resolved return type.
assertions.intent_evidence: Source and supported-version reproductions establish the defect. No exact upstream callable-default issue was found in the searches performed.

assertions.cause: Older plugin versions do not validate defaults field values. Later hooks validate literal defaults against model create setter types.
assertions.intent_evidence: Missing validation acknowledged by issue 1307 and added by PRs 3309 and 3326. Nonliteral dictionaries are still deliberately skipped.

assertions.cause: Older plugin versions do not validate defaults field values. Later hooks validate literal defaults against model create setter types.

assertions.cause: Older plugin versions do not validate defaults field values. Later hooks validate literal defaults against model create setter types.
assertions.intent_evidence: Missing validation acknowledged by issue 1307 and added by PRs 3309 and 3326. Nonliteral dictionaries are still deliberately skipped.

assertions.cause: The plugin parses the field prefix and checks the final lookup, but does not reject an unknown intermediate transform. The original string RHS masks this defect in newer releases.
assertions.intent_evidence: Permissive fallback exists in source. No exact issue for this invalid intermediate transform was found; PR 3655 addresses known transform output types, not this failure.

assertions.cause: Older In declarations and lookup resolution lose the iterable requirement. PR 3314 makes In expect Iterable[field exact type].
assertions.intent_evidence: Acknowledged lookup typing bug, fixed upstream.

assertions.cause: Integer exact lookups permit coercible str values and In expects an iterable of them. Plain str satisfies Iterable[str], without proving that every character is numeric.
assertions.intent_evidence: Explicit upstream test accepts age__in="abc" and explains why. This is a known value-content limitation.

assertions.cause: An unresolved QuerySet.as_manager type during semantic analysis blocks the generated manager and falls back to Any. A custom AUTH_USER_MODEL participates in the cycle.
assertions.intent_evidence: Acknowledged upstream defect. A controlled concept backport of PR 2377 removes both assertion failures and the stray manager diagnostic.

assertions.cause: An unresolved QuerySet.as_manager type during semantic analysis blocks the generated manager and falls back to Any. A custom AUTH_USER_MODEL participates in the cycle.
assertions.intent_evidence: Acknowledged upstream defect. A controlled concept backport of PR 2377 removes both assertion failures and the stray manager diagnostic.

assertions.cause: Default primary-key getters deliberately remain nonnullable; raw relation ID getters use field-level nullability, including field.null and default rules. The tested relation is nonnullable with no default. Construction and persistence states are not separately represented.
assertions.intent_evidence: Explicit getter/setter policy in plugin source and tests. PR 634 permits assigning None to AutoField while retaining a nonnullable getter; ergonomic motivation is inferred, not a found maintainer statement.

assertions.cause: Old stubs accept Iterable[str] without model-field validation. The later save hook checks literal update_fields collections.
assertions.intent_evidence: Historical missing validation, added by PR 3444. Dynamic collections remain deliberately outside the literal check.

assertions.cause: Old bulk_update declarations do not validate model-specific field names. The later plugin hook mirrors Django field checks without executing an update.
assertions.intent_evidence: Historical missing validation, added by PR 2808.

assertions.cause: Old order_by accepts strings without resolving fields. The later hook validates literal ordering paths.
assertions.intent_evidence: Historical missing validation, added by PR 3158.

assertions.cause: Old only accepts strings without field resolution. The later hook forces get_select_mask to validate selected fields.
assertions.intent_evidence: Historical missing validation, added by PR 3165.

assertions.cause: Old plugin releases lack inference for attributes created by Prefetch(to_attr=...). Later releases add list-valued annotations and generic Prefetch inference.
assertions.intent_evidence: Historical missing feature, requested in issue 795 and added by PRs 2779 and 2786.

634.title: Should be possible to set AutoField (e.g. id) to None

2377.title: Break what apparently is a cycle involving custom User model and `QuerySet.as_manager()`

2779.title: Initial support for `to_attr` inference in `Prefetch` calls

2786.title: Declare `Prefetch` as generic and do specialization in the plugin

3326.title: Type-check defaults and create_defaults dict literals

3444.title: Typecheck save()/asave() update_fields against model fields

3642.title: Add a mutable HttpRequest typing helper
